text:
PM is 66.8° against the 70° target. Every other spec passes with margin, and UGBW is about 2x the requirement. That leaves room to raise Cc, which lowers UGBW and gives more pole separation. Raising I7 pushes the second pole (p2) higher, and power still fits: about 1.07 mW at 1.98 V with I7 = 450 µA. Retuning krz moves the compensation zero. The topology is fine, so a numerical refine of the parameters should be enough.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Only PM fails (66.8 vs 70). UGBW has 2x margin; raise Cc, increase I7 to push p2 out, tune krz for zero placement. Power headroom allows I7 up to ~450uA at 1.98V.",
 "params": {"Cc": 2.6e-12, "I7": 340e-6, "krz": 1.0, "Itail": 80e-6},
 "bounds": {"Cc": [1.8e-12, 3.5e-12], "I7": [220e-6, 450e-6], "krz": [0.5, 1.5], "Itail": [60e-6, 130e-6]}}
```
